known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Identity confirmation needs an explicit yes/'that's me'/'speaking'/own name; ask at most twice (a customer question answered first does not reset), then close not_reached/unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): Convert spoken dates of birth to YYYY-MM-DD; numeric-only dates are day, month, year. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Declining security questions: explain once that they protect the account; a second refusal or second 'what is this about' closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Interpret 'next <weekday>' as following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as current week. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Floor offer after 'too much' and floor offer after below-floor amount are each made once; refusal of the floor or of the offered deadline is a flat refusal using an attempt. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Track per-product persuasion attempts by band; never repeat an offer the customer already refused; a customer-proposed date or amount is never a refusal. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Hardship (illness, death in family, job loss) suppresses all persuasion and takes precedence over rules 30 and 41; customer-named date/amount still recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Any change of date or amount at confirmation invalidates the confirmation; re-check and read back again before create_promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Recorded promises cannot be changed or cancelled; refer to the mobile app; one promise per product. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help first; transfer to general only if they insist. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Two statements of not wanting to talk close the call (no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before). - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): On any transfer, add no notes before or after; agreed but unrecorded promises are not recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage closing): No-promise close reason in multi-product calls is the note reason of the first product in get_account order whose note is not paid; all paid -> paid. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok: true. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
